name: UK weather warnings
summary: Met Office yellow ice and snow warnings cover Scotland, northern England and the Midlands from 15 to 17 Nov
state: At 05:40 UTC on 16 Nov the Met Office had yellow warnings in force or issued for ice across much of Scotland and northern England, and for snow on 17 Nov across southern Scotland, northern England, Yorkshire and the East and West Midlands; no amber or red warnings were issued (Met Office). Yellow warnings across this many regions count as widespread, so the level rises to Watch.
for_you: Follow Met Office warnings and local travel advice; ice and snow can disrupt roads and rail in the affected regions.
rubric_hit: Widespread yellow snow and ice warnings = Watch
basis_detail: raised above the data floor on reported events
why: Met Office warnings are the official signal for disruption to travel, power and safety in the UK.
drivers: Storms, heavy rain, snow and ice, heat, fog, thunderstorms.

rubric.watch: Widespread yellow or any amber warning in force.
rubric.normal: No warnings, or only localised yellow warnings.
